title: Tanga ustiga bemalol sig'adigan umurtqali hayvon qaysi?

scenes.text: 2012 yilda olimlar o'rtacha uzunligi atigi 7,7 millimetr bo'lgan umurtqali hayvonni ta'rifladi.
U Papua-Yangi Gvineya o'rmonida, xazonlar orasida yashaydi. Ovozi hasharotnikiga o'xshaydi.
Bu Paedophryne amauensis degan qurbaqa. O'shanda u dunyodagi eng kichik umurtqali hayvon deb e'lon qilindi.
Olimlar uni 2009 yilda ovoziga quloq solib topishgan.

description:
Paedophryne amauensis qurbaqasining o'rtacha uzunligi taxminan 7,7 millimetr. U Papua-Yangi Gvineyada 2009 yilda ovozi orqali topilgan va 2012 yilda ta'riflanganda dunyodagi eng kichik umurtqali hayvon deb e'lon qilingan.

Siz buni bilarmidingiz? Izohda "ha" yoki "yo'q" deb yozing.
source: Web fact-check 2026-11-20 (web search summaries; pages could not be opened from this session). Rittmeyer, Allison, Grundler, Thompson and Austin, PLoS ONE 7(1): e29797, January 2012, 'Ecological Guild Evolution and the Discovery of the World's Smallest Vertebrate' (pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3256195: smallest known vertebrate, mean adult size 7.7 mm, leaf litter of Papua New Guinea, cricket-like call; displaced the fish Paedocypris progenetica 7.9-10.3 mm); holotype collected 7 Aug 2009 near Amau Village (Plazi, AmphibiaWeb, Amphibian Species of the World); National Geographic and CS Monitor, Jan 2012 (announcement). The later record claim in the writer's note (Brachycephalus pulex 2024) was not checked; the text says 'O'shanda ... e'lon qilindi', which holds either way.
